gate_title: Canonical suite topology and heavyweight-assurance remediation
authority_granted: create a versioned deterministic shard manifest/registry derived from the exact legacy unittest-discovered population
partition that population across bounded parallel shadow jobs with exact-one membership and deterministic ordering
add union-completeness, no-duplication, no-omission and deterministic-repeatability proofs
run the shard candidate in shadow beside all existing required checks
measure exact-head shard critical path, runner overhead and repeatability
prepare coordinated cutover evidence compatible with PYT-G2 or a later explicit superseding operator decision
authority_not_granted: remove, skip, demote or replace standalone unittest
remove, skip, demote or replace pytest-unittest-parity or runner-parity
admit pytest-native tests into the canonical surface
enable pytest-xdist or any unordered process-parallel runner
change benchmark freshness, scientific evidence semantics or heavy-test assertions
activate shard output as a substitute for any existing required check
grant scientific, semantic, Validation, selector, publication, probability, risk, exposure or execution authority
rollback: If the shadow candidate fails, remove or supersede only candidate shard manifests, shadow jobs and candidate tooling. Preserve all current required checks, PYT policy, stable-main readiness and historical evidence. Never force-push or rewrite history.
